SELECT 
	Client = SPACE(100),
	DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), SL.PostDate, 101),
	CustomerGroup=(SELECT MAX(CG.Name) FROM CustomerGroup CG, CustomerGroupDetail CGD WHERE CG.CustomerGroupCode=CGD.CustomerGroupCode AND CGD.CustCode=C.CustCode),
	CustomerCode=A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	InvoiceCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	ItemAliasCode=I.CustomICode,
	ItemQty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	BonusQty=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	ItemGrossAmount=ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice), 2),
	PreDiscPerc = SUM(Round((SD.ItemFlatDisc / CASE WHEN SD.SalePrice = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.SalePrice END) * 100, 2)),
	DiscPerc = SD.DiscPerc, 
	TotalDiscountPerc=ROUND(((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01))) / CASE WHEN SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) END) * 100, 2),
	ItemDiscountAmount=ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)),2),
	ItemNetSalesAmount=ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2),
	SalesTaxPerc= ROUND(((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2)) / CASE WHEN ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) END) * 100, 0),
	SalesTaxAmount=ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),2),
	AdvanceTaxPerc=ROUND(SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,2),
	AdvanceTaxAmount= ROUND((SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)) * SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2),
	SalesType=CASE WHEN SL.SaleCatCode = 3 THEN 'Cash' ELSE 'Credit' END
FROM
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE 
	:as_crs = 'N' AND
	:as_reporttype = 'S' AND
	SL.Posted='Y' AND
	SL.PostDate BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	SL.SaleInvCode=SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	SL.PostDate,
	C.CustCode,
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.SaleCatCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SD.DiscPerc,
	SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
UNION ALL
